Implement only the approved contract with Python 3.12+, Pydantic v2, SQLModel, Alembic, FastAPI, SQLite for RND, and Celery for production. Use SQLAlchemy only when SQLModel requires configuration below repository boundaries. Preserve transaction, provenance, authorization, idempotency, migration, retry, and observability behavior. Keep local persistence behind repository/service boundaries. Add focused tests and update API/domain documentation. Handoff browser, agent, or infrastructure questions to the matching specialist.
